none: PAS CAM-E78D16: Copper-alloy, probably a Contemporary Copy of a, Nummus of Crispus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IVL CRISPVS NOB C ; R/ BEATA TRANQVILLITAS

A copper-alloy Roman coin, probably a contemporary copy, of a nummus of Crispus, 317-326. Mint is shown as Trier, c.321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse shows laureate bust right holding eagle-tipped sceptre. Obverse legend reads IVL CRISPVS NOB C. Reverse shows altar inscribed VOT/IS surmounted by globe. Reverse legend reads BEATA TRANQVILLITAS. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //.TP[crescent?].…
